projection.successRule: false only for execution_error; rejection, stale_basis, unavailable and unknown are domain outcomes, not affirmative execution claims

hostPolicy.completionRoute: new command_ingress-admitted command, not implemented here
hostPolicy.bootstrap: Host binds the conversation to an admitted session; read_model_summary takes no arguments and returns its handle and basis. Handles do not establish identity or authority.
hostPolicy.handles: Host-issued opaque workspace/proposal/run/page handles; scoped to admitted generation and workspace; never filesystem paths. Restart invalidates handles; unavailable/unknown, never redispatch. Cursor binds tool, basis, run and next offset.
hostPolicy.attribution: Host stamps author_type=agent and original conversation/turn/call; never accepts user attribution from tool arguments.
hostPolicy.proposal: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before queue registration. The agent supplies native EditorOperationIntent operation_id, operation_kind, target, change and rationale for the admitted discriminators only; the host stamps operation_status=proposed, author_type=agent, queue_id, source, not-run validation and the constant audit and professional boundary records, and passes the complete native intents to a host-created OperationBatch. No alternate field-edit language. Admitted: set_field Node position.x/y/z; create_material; create_node; connect_pipe_run; create_support; create_load_case; create_primitive_load; update_load pressure_regions; set_field Model pressure_profile. Extend native discriminators and subschemas, not tool names. The Rust applier remains the semantic validator; it refuses agent-written bend flexibility factors. Queue the immutable submission via the existing preview/human apply route.
hostPolicy.completion: Resolve requestRef to the immutable original pending call and require its conversation/turn/call/tool, workspace and application-generation binding. The submitting webview must remain the admitted session. For summary/node reads require unchanged live revision through completion. For queued proposals, observations, solves and result reads validate the host-retained proposal/run record against its captured basis; a later live revision is permitted only as an explicitly historical/applied outcome, never rebased to current. Duplicate or forged completions and wrong/detached sessions are refused. Preserve already admitted application outcome as actual or unknown on loss; never redispatch.
hostPolicy.interruption: Withdraw pending review only; application already admitted yields actual outcome or unknown. Turn interruption is not solve cancellation or rollback.
hostPolicy.limits: Apply the smaller of catalog caps and existing admission budgets before parsing/allocating argument or result payloads; bounded producers, no whole-model serialization followed by truncation.
hostPolicy.results: Use existing permitted view/value-record semantics and redaction floors. No raw private row bypass. Preserve exact decimal where required; withheld/unavailable has no numeric value. A run handle binds its evaluated model hash, never relabel historical results as current.
hostPolicy.autonomy: No apply/accept/release/grant tools. Any later autonomy needs separately authorized host policy and implementation.
hostPolicy.solve: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before handleRun; retain evaluated hash even if run id changes. Return session solverMode, health and run handle; progress only to existing supported notifications/panel.
hostPolicy.proposalContext: Require an explicit bounded assumptions array (empty means none declared), separate from unchanged native operation intents and per-operation rationale. Each assumption has a stable id, statement and existing affected operation ids. Validate id uniqueness and operation membership; capture immutable context with proposal handle, batch id, original attribution and basis. Display it with the queue and retain it with session outcomes/receipts, including reject/withdraw/unknown; do not inject extra fields into native intents or claim durable persistence.
hostPolicy.basisAdmission: Summary has no caller basis. Node reads, proposal submission and solve admission require the current live basis. Proposal observation uses the host-retained proposal basis; result reads use the host-retained evaluated run basis. All require the admitted workspace/application generation. Historical calls are not refused solely because the current model revision advanced.

filter.description: Optional. Keep only rows whose kind is listed (if kinds is non-empty) and whose entityRef is listed (if entityRefs is non-empty). A cursor is bound to its filter.

after.description: JSON text of the material: id, label, elastic_modulus {value, unit}, then either shear_modulus {value, unit} (default route) or constitutive_basis "homogeneous_isotropic_E_nu_v1" with poisson_ratio {value, unit "1"} (exact route); optional thermal_expansion_coefficient {value, unit "1/<project temperature unit>"}; provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source)
JSON text of the node: id, label, position {x, y, z} as numbers in project.units.length, provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source)

JSON text of the straight pipe: id, label, from and to (existing or earlier-in-batch node ids), section {outside_diameter {value, unit}, wall_thickness {value, unit}, and corrosion_allowance {value, unit} before the exact route is activated}, material (material id), y_reference {x, y, z} (a direction not parallel to the pipe), provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source)
JSON text of the support: id, label, node (node id), family (for example "anchor"), restraints (subset of UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ), provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source)
JSON text of the load case: id, label, kind "primitive_user_load", status "preview_only", provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source)

ref.description: Existing or earlier-in-batch load case id

after.description: JSON text of the primitive load: id, category, target, direction, magnitude {value, unit} (unit equal to change.unit), dimension (equal to change.dimension), provenance (non-empty text naming the person's stated source). By category: thermal: target {type "element", pipe}, direction global_x, global_y or global_z, dimension temperature_interval; distributed_force: target {type "element", pipe}, direction global_x|y|z, dimension force_per_length; concentrated_force: target {type "node", node}, direction global_x|y|z, dimension force; concentrated_moment: target {type "node", node}, direction rotation_x, rotation_y or rotation_z, dimension moment; imposed_displacement: target {type "support", support, dof}, direction equal to dof (UX, UY or UZ with dimension displacement; RX, RY or RZ with dimension rotation).

unit.description: The magnitude's unit, matching the project unit for its dimension

ref.description: Existing or earlier-in-batch load case id

before.description: "not_present" for a case without pressure_regions, otherwise the case's current regions as canonical JSON text

after.description: JSON text of the case's pressure_regions array; "[]" declares none

JSON text {schema_version, pressure_contract {version "3.0.0", mode "exact_pressure_v3", shear_model "euler_bernoulli" or "timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1"}} activating the exact route; every pipe needs section.corrosion_allowance and every load case a pressure_regions array first

tools.name: swbpipe_propose_operations
tools.description: Queue native operation intents as one atomic batch for the person's review; never applies them. Each operation is an applier step on the document the previous step left, so later operations may name ids created earlier in the same batch. To build a model, order: materials, nodes, pipes, supports, load cases, then (exact route only) pressure_regions and pressure_profile, then primitive loads. Use the summary's current basis and model hash. After the person applies it, observe the proposal, re-read the summary for the new basis, then solve. The host stamps attribution, status and boundary fields; do not send them. Respect the summary's limits.
tools.availability: admitted live webview workspace; adapters not yet implemented
tools.sourceRoute: workspaceSession.ts registerOperationBatch; operationBatchService.ts validateOperationBatch; operation_applier atomic batch (admitted change kinds listed by summary)
tools.canonicalUnits: node coordinates: exact project.units.length; result values: source row unit, no display conversion
tools.basisPolicy: Current live basis and claimedModelHash required before queue registration. Completion binds immutable registration/proposal basis and actual recorded standing; a subsequent revision change does not erase the acknowledged registration or an actual applied outcome.
